I also updated every call site that passes an int hash, which is 10 lines across 7 files in `pulsar-broker`. I left the `select(byte[])` overload and its caller in `PersistentDispatcherSingleActiveConsumer` alone, since you asked for only the `int` variant. I also left the unrelated `BrokerSelectionStrategy.select` methods alone. `managed-ledger`, `pulsar-metadata`, `pulsar-common` and `pulsar-broker-common` had no matches. I did not run Maven or any build, as instructed.
